title: Slow Drag Pavageau in 1923, Sandpaper George and homemade instruments
summary: He remembers meeting Slow Drag in 1923, Sandpaper George, and a bass he made out of a box.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I'm telling you. But they got a lot of young ones now. Get tired. Can't hold up like he do. Can't do like he do. He really works. He works. Now, that's a man started out. I remember slow drag. I remember slow drag in 1923. I met him. A young fella. He came in and another fella he called George. Sandpaper George. Yeah. Hudson had a horn made out of pipe.

Yeah, they used to go out like, or even night most of them. Get out there and start around and see what could they pick up. They're doing good. Then when I was seeing slow drag in 1923. I made him a bass out of box.
Yeah, he played out of box. And then I did come to fire way back here lately. He goes stuff
and he got to playing and then Joey Lewis took it. He played good. But he been fooling around with guitar and a thing a long time.
Yeah. He's a nice fella too.
He's a nice fella. Yeah, he is a nice fella.
Well, I must write him a postcard too. A lot of fellas there I was sending some postcards to this morning. I haven't sent one to Drag.
